card.name: Words just before Murray-Darling names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as the, of, by and lower that come right before "Murray" or "Murray-Darling" in Australian river and wetland text. It also fires on a few similar spots in Australian reports.

modes.label: Before Murray River names
modes.description: A linking word or adjective right before Murray, Murray River or Murray-Darling in text about Australian rivers and wetlands.
modes.example: Prior to the flooding in 2010–11 the last overbank flow in this region of<< the>> Murray River was in 200

modes.label: Other Australian report spots
modes.description: A word at the start of a clause in Australian institutional text, where a consultation or funding body is named next.
modes.example: ACARA released discussion papers on the development of the new curriculum.<< Following>> member consultation Engineers Australia compiled a submission making

card.writes: The promoted tokens are consultation and arrangement words, with no obvious link to the rivers, and the suppressed tokens are packet and block words.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word just before the name Murray-Darling in Australian river reports.
